Configure emails to be sent when new form submissions are received.

**Notification recipients:**
- Enter the address (or addresses) the notification goes to in To / CC / BCC. Form settings are kept in a private repository, so an address here is not public.
- A form may still name a role key such as `{{ config:forms.recipients.institutional_relations }}`; it sends to that key's address until it is replaced with an address.
- How recipients are set is described in `docs/forms/notification-recipients.md`.

**Available Merge Tags:**
- `{{ admin_email }}` - Site default email address
- `{{ form:title }}` - Form title
- `{{ form:handle }}` - Form handle/ID
- `{{ submission:id }}` - Form submission/entry ID
- `{{ submission:<handle> }}` - Access form field values (replace `<handle>` with field handle)
  - Example: `{{ submission:email }}` for email field, `{{ submission:name }}` for name field
- `{{ all_fields }}` - All form fields in a formatted table
  - `{{ all_fields show_value="true" }}` - Show actual values instead of labels
  - `{{ all_fields show_empty="true" }}` - Show fields with no submitted values
  - `{{ all_fields hide_hidden="true" }}` - Hide hidden field types
- `{{ referrer }}` - Referring page URL
- `{{ ip }}` - Submitter's IP address
- `{{ today }}` - Current date (Jan. 1, 2025)
- `{{ today:time }}` - Current time (1:23 a.m.)
- `{{ today:timestamp }}` - Unix timestamp
- `{{ today format="Y-m-d" }}` - Custom date format
- `{{ quiz }}` - Quiz question with answer and correct answer
  - `{{ quiz handle="*" }}` - Specific quiz question
- `{{ quiz:grade }}` - Quiz letter grade (A, B, C, D, F)
- `{{ quiz:passfail }}` - Quiz pass/fail result
- `{{ quiz:percent }}` - Quiz percentage score
- `{{ quiz:score }}` - Quiz total score
  - `{{ quiz:score handle="*" }}` - Specific quiz question score
- `{{ survey }}` - Survey question with answer
  - `{{ survey handle="*" }}` - Specific survey question
- `{{ survey:score }}` - Survey total score
  - `{{ survey:score handle="*" }}` - Specific survey question score
